# volcano_durable_function_scheduler (Resource)

A cron trigger attached to a durable function.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "volcano_durable_function_scheduler" "nightly" {
  project_id      = volcano_project.example.id
  function_id     = volcano_durable_function.workflow.id
  name            = "nightly"
  cron_expression = "0 0 * * *"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cron_expression` (String) Standard 5-field cron expression, evaluated in UTC.
- `function_id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `payload` (String) JSON-encoded object passed to the function on each scheduled invocation, e.g. jsonencode({ foo = "bar" }).
- `regions` (List of String) At most one explicit deployed region. If omitted, the scheduler picks one deployed region itself.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `next_run_at` (String)
- `run_count` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import volcano_durable_function_scheduler.nightly <project-id>,<function-id>,<scheduler-id>
```
